parsed.rationale: All four duplicate `data` methods reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and are nested inside per-test-class `SequentialMockSession` helper types (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`). Although the context flags do not set `is_test: true`, the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`) and the enclosing type names (all suffixed `Tests`) make clear these are test-internal mock session helpers. The structural duplication is incidental to each test class owning its own self-contained mock; consolidating them would couple otherwise independent test fixtures. No action is warranted.
